description: Source code for xprepare.c, part of the LibXDiff library, implementing file differencing and comparison functions.

classes.name: xdlclass_t
classes.description: Represents a classified record with linked list for hash chaining.

classes.name: xdlclassifier_t
classes.description: Holds hash table and classification data for file diffing.

methods.name: xdl_init_classifier
methods.description: Initializes the classifier with hash table and record arrays.

methods.name: xdl_free_classifier
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for the classifier.

methods.name: xdl_classify_record
methods.description: Classifies a record into the classifier, updating hash chains.

methods.name: xdl_free_ctx
methods.description: Frees context data for a file.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_ctx
methods.description: Prepares context for diffing a file, including hashing and classification.

methods.name: xdl_clean_mmatch
methods.description: Determines if a line should be discarded based on neighboring lines and window size.

methods.name: xdl_cleanup_records
methods.description: Removes unmatchable or redundant records to optimize diff process.

methods.name: xdl_trim_ends
methods.description: Trims matching records from the start and end of files.

methods.name: xdl_optimize_ctxs
methods.description: Optimizes file contexts by trimming and cleaning records.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_env
methods.description: Prepares environment for diffing two files, including hashing, classification, and optimization.
